adjudication.rationale: The diff shows SalesforceCalendarService now unconditionally performs a refresh-token POST to `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` and then writes the refreshed token data back with `prisma.credential.update(...)` before constructing the `jsforce.Connection` (see added block starting with `const response = await fetch(...)` and the subsequent `await prisma.credential.update(...)`). Unlike other integrations modified in this PR, Salesforce does not use the new `refreshOAuthTokens` helper, so even when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` are set, Salesforce will still refresh directly using the locally stored `credentialKey.refresh_token` rather than delegating to the sync endpoint. This is a concrete, diff-grounded inconsistency and potential performance/regression concern, though whether it is strictly a correctness bug depends on intended requirements not shown in the diff.
